data.name: Planks Wars
data.detailed_description:
When a sect of 200-foot-tall wizards starts kidnapping adventurers, it only means one thing: a turn-based PvP card tournament. OBVIOUSLY!

Planks Wars is a light hearted fantasy cross platform card battler that blends CCG deckbuilding with an RPG party brawl. Each player commands a party of heroes with one simple goal: defeat the entire opposing party.

Draw. Plan. No regrets! Every turn you draw 3 tablets carved from the very Great Black Tree. Tablets belong to specific heroes, and you can issue only one command per hero per turn, so planning is everything. Don't need a tablet? Sacrifice it to fuel artifacts and gain crucial effects like damage, healing, or mana. Why waste magic wood when you can turn it into trouble for someone else? Recycling is important!

Pick. Order. Chaos. Targets and lane movement are automatic, so anyone can play instantly, even a four-foot-tall wizard apprentice. Then comes the serious part: the order of your commands, their timing, and your heroes’ growth can mean the difference between glorious victory and total humiliation in front of the Sect.

Skill-first, no trading, no grinding, no pay-to-win.

Will you embrace the power of the Great Black Tree and dominate the Warboard... or be turned to dust and swept beneath the Grand Master Wizard’s carpet?

Key Features (Steam bullet format)

  • Fast Turn-based online cross platform PvP with 5-10 minutes card battles

  • No IAP, no pay-to-win: skill decides the winner

  • Simple controls thanks to targeting and lane movement automatically handled

  • Command a 2–4 hero party and wipe the enemy team to win

  • Draw 3 tablets per turn and sequence actions with wits

  • One command per hero per turn equals constant tactical choices

  • Heroes level up during the match as you play their tablets

  • 60 tablets, 4 heroes (more coming)

data.short_description: Planks Wars is a fast, irreverent cross-platform PvP card battler where 200-foot-tall sorcerers use kidnapped adventurers as tournament pawns. Build your strategy with CCG-style deckbuilding, command your puppets... I mean, heroes, and climb the ranks.
data.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo (2,2 GHz) o AMD Athlon 64 X2 (2,6 GHz)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 240 GT o ATI Radeon HD 4850
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
